notes: B1 of the eight chunks. Brand app, Campaigns tab: 22 screens — 3 new, 15 changed, 4 untouched. Screens drawn and every button specified. NOTHING IS BUILT until the founder locks the mockups.
scope: Only the Campaigns tab of the brand app. The Creators tab is B2, the creator's side is B5, admin is B8.
the_rule: A set is one aim, one posting date, one shoot mode. Everything else is per creator. Posting date >= today + 7; invitations close 3 days before; a store visit finishes 1 day before.
new_screens: Her terms — one screen carrying commission/money, deliverables, what she can sell, her offer and her channels. Replaces the entire second brief.
She countered the money — she stays in the set.
She countered the date or the mode — accept and move her to a matching set, or decline. THE RISKIEST SCREEN IN B1: nothing in the app has ever moved a row between sets.
heaviest_change: Set wizard step 2 (Basics). Gains the shoot mode and one posting date; loses the two-field posting window, the channels and the deliverables — the last two move to each creator.
decisions_owed: Does 'by filter' get a screen now? It exists in the database and has never had one, so only two of the three invite routes actually work.
When she is moved to a matching set, does she re-confirm? Recommendation: NO — she lands on the exact terms she asked for, so asking again would be the double-ask this architecture removes.

release.deploy_class: deploy-inert — mockups and specification only, no code
